thread.title: Apple earnings to focus on iPhone sales, billions for investors: Live blog - MarketWatch

author: Jeremy C. Owens   and   Emily Bary
title: Apple earnings to focus on iPhone sales, billions for investors: Live blog - MarketWatch
text:
Published: May 1, 2018 3:59 p.m. ET Share
Apple expected to update shareholder-return program while looking to spend about $160 billion
By Technology Editor Emily Bary
Apple Inc. is scheduled to release earnings after the bell Tuesday, with a focus on iPhone X sales and investor return.
While expectations for iPhone sales have declined since Apple AAPL, +2.32% last reported earnings and dashed hopes for a “supercycle,” there has still been a lot of anxiety among analysts and investors about the smartphone. Apple also typically updates its shareholder-return plan along with its fiscal second-quarter earnings, and investors expect a big bump this year after Apple promised to spend billions in cash that was previously parked overseas.
MarketWatch tech editor Jeremy C. Owens (@jowens510) and reporter Emily Bary (@emilybary) will live-blog the earnings report’s release, expected at 4:30 p.m. Eastern time, and subsequent conference call, scheduled for 5 p.m. Quote References
